requirements.description: The user prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
User prefers an energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are included. Floor area, capacity, school use and proximity to green spaces are not energy-related and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area.
